recipes.name: Carla's Fruit Dip
ingredients_raw: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, mix whipped topping, marshmallow cream, and cream cheese together until smooth. Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Carla's Fruit Dip
raw_recipe.description: This creamy fruit dip made with marshmallow fluff, cool whip, and cream cheese is delicious served chilled with an array of freshly sliced fruit.

review.reviewBody: This was an excellent fruit dip (and a huge hit). I did follow others advice and used 8 oz of cream cheese rather than 3. I think that made a huge difference. I also used extra creamy cool whip which made it thicker (and made it stick to the fruit more!). I used strawberry cream cheese, but think it would also be excellent with pineapple or mixed berry cream cheese. Whipping the cream cheese prior to adding the marshmallow cream and whipped topping is a good way to avoid lumps. I will be making this again!

This is great! I made it for a party, served it with strawberries,cantelope,honeydew,and pineapple chunks, and everyone loved it! I,too, added 8 oz. of cream cheese and a little vanilla and it came out perfectly. I whipped the cream cheese first, then whipped in the marshmallow cream, then the whipped topping. Absolutely no little lumps of cream cheese. Yes.it made quite a lot, but no one in my family complained about HAVING to eat what was left over!

This was a great dip. I took a lot of the other reviewers' suggestions. I used 8oz of cream cheese and it was the perfect consistency. Following another reviewer's advice, I beat/added the ingredients in the following order: cream cheese(softened), marshmallow creme (a little melted), and cool whip (not quite the whole container). I had no lumps and it was a perfect consistency for sticking to fruit. I also added about 2 T of orange juice, 1 T of cinnamon, and 1 T of vanilla extract. I took it to a baby shower and everyone had many servings of it. This recipe makes plenty. Enough for many servings for 20-25 people I'd say. I also used low fat or fat free everything and it tasted great.

I thought the idea shared earlier in reviews to add the Eagle Brand Sweetened condensed milk? would be a good idea. I followed the recipe w/ the Cool Whip and Marshmallow Cream, but added the full 8 oz. block of cream cheese and 1/2 cup of the Sweetened condensed milk. Unfortunately, I thought it turned out way too sweet. I lightened it with a teaspoon of vanilla extract and the zest and juice of a whole lemon. I served it with fruit kabobs (Strawberries, pineapple, grapes, bananas and cantaloupe)? and it was a hit! I made the dip a day ahead and it was much better tasting after sitting overnight. I can’t wait to try this with other variations like orange or Chambord?!
Dip turned out great, was a hit at the party. I whipped the strawberry cream cheese first before adding the other 2 ingredients.

So simple, and yet absolutely amazing! I followed some of the other reviews and used Extra Creamy Cool Whip (not quite the whole container), 8 oz regular cream cheese, and about 8-9 oz of marshmallow cream. I also added a few Tblsp powdered sugar and mixed in some finely chopped strawberries. It's even better the next day in my opinion. If I were using apples, I would change it up a bit. This is a definite keeper!

this recipe is pretty thin and sweet as written. the first time I made it, I didn't realize it called for a 3 oz pkg of cream cheese, so I made it with an 8 oz package, and I added 1/2 tsp each vanilla and lime juice. it tastes like cheesecake! and it's thick and delicious with strawberries, watermelon, canteloupe, kiwi, and grapes (all of which I served on my fruit tray). once I realized it called for 3 oz, I made it that way and liked it, but not as much as the version I accidentally made! I also use my version as a cream cheese icing on cinnamon rolls, for homemade soft pretzels, and on cupcakes. yum! thanks for the recipe!

I followed suggestions by some of the other reviewers and added Eagle Brand milk (low fat), 1 tsp vanilla, and about 3 tbsp. powdered sugar. It was great and at a church function of women, even though it made a large mixing bowl, only 3 oz were left afterward ! One lady said, it's better than ice cream!

I prepared this for a wedding reception, I made a few changes as follows, whip 2 - 8 ounce packs of low fat cream cheese add vanilla and a little of almond extract add about 1/3 cup of powdered sugar then add a 7 ounce jar of marshmallow creme last, fold in an 8 ounce extra creamy cool whip. Can make the day of event, but is better the next day. Sticks well to the fruit, used it with strawberries, pineapple, apple, and grapes. I sprinkled some splenda to the fruit the night before to add more sweetness. YUM!

I started to make this as written but ended up adding the full 8oz of cream cheese. I used regular cream cheese and extra creamy cool whip. I started by "creaming" together the cream cheese and marshmallow cream. After tasting this I added the rest of my cream cheese. The cream cheese helps cut some of the sweetness. Also creaming together the marshmallow cream and cream cheese helps make sure you don't have lumps. I then folded in the cool whip. My husband loved the dip and it may be a good thing to keep on hand when he is looking for a snack.

Love this recipe. I make a yellow cake drizzle vanilla syrup over the bottom layer then use the dip for frosting. Add the second layer drizzle more syrup an another layer of dip, then top with fresh blueberries and strawberries. Think you will love it. I always get compliments and never have any left over.

I made this for my book club this week and got RAVE reviews from everyone. I did not change a thing and found this to be amazingly delicious. I will definitely make again. Thanks so much for the recipe, Carla!!

Love this. Have made it for years. I serve strawberries with it and sometimes apples and grapes. I can never get all the lumps out, though, even which I mix the cream cheese first and let everything reach room temperature.
I made this for my daughter and her friends and they absolutely LOVED it! I didn't even get to try it so if a bunch of teenagers scarf down a whole bowl of dip, you know it's good!
I made this with 8 ozs. of cream cheese and it is yummy!
Amazingly delicious!!
This is a favorite for kids' parties or potlucks. I use 8oz of cream cheese and add a cherry yogurt for color and flavor. it is delicious!
I've made this recipe for a few years. but lost the recipe in our move 3 years back and just found it again can't wait to make it for the 4th of July. ..
This is my FAVORITE fruit dip! I did use 8 oz. cream cheese and added a couple tablespoons of cherry juice. Everyone raves over this recipe. Thanks Carla.
No changes, Yes, I will make it again.
